reviews.reviewbody:
Great to have PSX now but there's many NTSC missing and some missing letters on PAL & NTSC-J. Is it a bug or do you plan to update them soon?

Thanks again for your awesome work!

thanks !! 
By the way is there any DAT to verify those CHDs ??
These are great. Thank you. I hope you come back one day, though. We do miss you and hope you continue to update to preserve everything.
